description: Virix — spores, flowers, production on BISMUTH.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Welcome to the Virix tutorial. The hive thrives where BISMUTH burns hottest.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: The Spore captures sites. It is fragile and cannot attack, but flies over terrain.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: When a Spore captures a site it becomes a seed that blooms into a flower next turn.

steps.textAfter: The flower pollenates the tile and spawns a free Spore each turn.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Stronger Virix units are built on captured BISMUTH. Select your owned node.

steps.textAfter: Produce again from the same node when you are ready.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Well done — you understand Virix growth and production.
